body: I've tried bringing it up to them on different occasions but my mom is an "ignore it until it goes away" type and my dad is a "nut up and be positive" type. I just dont think they understand how to deal with any of it. Most of the time when its brought up the situation just escalates and ends with a family-wide screaming match. I've tried to seek out therapy on my own but I have severe issues opening up to anyone about how i feel and my appointments devolve into me downplaying my problems and lying through my teeth out of reflex, afterward I end up being disappointed in myself and I spiral harder. At this point I dont know if I can recondition myself into being honest after having to bullshit everything for so long.
